question.text: Bhima Growth AIF's Manager is preparing a 'Disciplinary History' disclosure for the DDQ. Ch 12 requires this disclosure to cover a minimum period and scope of:

answer.text: Minimum 3 years, limited to SEBI actions only.
Minimum 10 years, limited to criminal convictions only.
Minimum 2 years, covering only the Investment Manager (not Sponsor).

Minimum 5 years for IM and Sponsor along with partners, directors, associates and Trustees — covering criminal/civil prosecution, statutory-due defaults, bank/FI defaults, economic-offence proceedings, SEBI/regulatory action, penalties and disputed tax liabilities.

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Ch 12 specifies a minimum 5-year clean record for the IM, Sponsor, and associated partners/directors/associates/Trustees, covering the full list: criminal/civil, non-payment of statutory dues, bank/FI defaults, economic offences, SEBI/regulatory disciplinary actions, penalties and disputed tax liabilities. **The Trap:** A-C narrow the scope incorrectly. **Cross-Exam Context:** Parallels XXI-B (PM) director-disclosure and XV (RA) registered-person disclosure norms. In XIX-C, LPs also cross-check with news/legal databases. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Run an annual background/litigation check on all senior partners through a Big-4 or specialist firm. Keep the certificate in the data room — saves 10 DDQ questions.
